We love hearing what explorers want next. Five quick questions A few useful answers picked from the app so you can get back to learning fast. QUESTION ANSWER How do I start learning in LinguaQuest? Choose your languages during onboarding, then continue to Home to start quests, lessons, and practice. What is Camera Hunt? Camera Hunt asks you to capture a real-world object and match it with the target vocabulary word. How does AI Image Verification work? After you take a photo, AI checks whether the object matches the target word before you earn rewards. How do I practice speaking? Use Voice Challenge or Review to speak out loud, then listen to instant pronunciation feedback. How do rewards and streaks work? You earn XP, coins, daily rewards, and streak progress as you keep learning every day. What\'s inside the guide? Product vision A gamified AI-powered language learning experience that combines real-world interaction, speech practice, and personalized feedback to make learning natural, engaging, and effective. Camera Hunt Capture real-world objects using the device camera and match them with target vocabulary words. AI Image Verification Use AI-powered image recognition to check whether the captured object matches the required vocabulary. Voice Challenge Practice speaking words and phrases through the microphone and get instant pronunciation feedback. Sentence Pronunciation Game Listen to sentences, repeat them aloud, and receive an AI score based on pronunciation, fluency, and clarity. AI Conversation Tutor Practice real-life conversations with an AI language tutor through voice interaction. Lock Screen Learning Learn vocabulary from the lock screen with daily words, translations, example sentences, and pronunciation guidance. Education Center Access structured lessons covering vocabulary, grammar, and cultural insights beyond the gameplay experience. Captured Photos Gallery Review previously captured objects with their vocabulary names, translations, and pronunciation to strengthen memory. Progress & Rewards Earn XP and coins, complete daily missions, maintain streaks, and track your learning journey. Multi-Language Support Learn multiple languages, switch between courses easily, and keep progress separate for each language. Unlock at Level %1$d Back
